name: Guwahati
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP population-weighted point is a settlement locator, not a parcel identity, municipal boundary, or coverage guarantee. No full parcel polygon geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Assam government identifies BhuNaksha cadastral mapping; official state handbook includes Guwahati plot-level land records. This confirms registry activity but not an open polygon API.
technicalBlocker: Public viewer’s map layer is WMS raster; separate detail route not queried. GeoHub could not be fetched locally.
remainingUncertainty: Whether new GeoHub contains an anonymous vector parcel layer and whether BhuNaksha has a full geometry endpoint.
nextStep: Inspect public GeoHub layer catalog only if reachable; do not query Dag, owner, or address details.
